run_reply.assistant_text:
No single option can be put forward: the comparison is a near tie, and small changes to modelled relationships could change it.

Recorded chances of reaching at least £126,000/month in this model are:
- Raise prices 10%: about 45%.
- Launch starter tier: about 46%.
- Keep pricing as it is: less than 1%, holding today’s values unchanged.

These are conditional model chances, not guarantees. Crucially, the nine-month deadline was not tested. Five values were supplied by Olumi, not you, and the analysis has not established which assumption most affects the comparison.

blocks.summary: No single option can be put forward yet. The result is not yet robust — small changes could flip it. Olumi works out ‘Starter-tier MRR’ as ‘Starter subscribers’ × ‘Starter tier monthly price’. That’s Olumi’s reading of how they combine; tell me if it’s wrong. 'Keep pricing as it is' was analysed as no change — the factors it compares against were held at the values your model records today. I supplied 5 of the values behind this, because your brief did not state them. They are mine rather than yours. Changing any of them changes what this model implies.
